snippets.name: Scalar dashboard
snippets.description: Declares representative signed, unsigned, floating-point, boolean, and size values, then combines them in a small calculation.

snippets.name: Mutable accumulator
snippets.description: Updates a mutable integer through several meaningful steps and returns the total.

snippets.name: Packet header
snippets.description: Decodes flags using hexadecimal, binary, octal, and separated integer literals.

app.hex: total: UInt32:= version.to<UInt32>() + low.to<UInt32>() + high.to<UInt32>() + mode.to<UInt32>() + port.to<UInt32>()

snippets.name: Text record
snippets.description: Combines String, Strand, Byte, and Rune values in one small record-like object.

app.hex: type Entry = { name: Strand, note: String, first: Rune, kind: Byte, }
entry: Entry:= Entry { name = "hexal", note = "hi", first = 'h', kind = b'\x01' }

snippets.name: Immutable snapshot
snippets.description: Copies an object, mutates the original, and reads the unchanged copy to demonstrate value copying.

app.hex: type Meter = { mut reading: Int32, unit: Strand, }
mut live: Meter:= Meter { reading = 10, unit = "kwh" }

snippets.name: Score alias
snippets.description: Defines a domain-specific numeric alias and uses it in an object.

app.hex: type Match = { mut home: Score, mut away: Score, }
mut game: Match:= Match { home = 2, away = 1 }

snippets.name: Boolean policy

app.hex: mut admitted: Bool:= (age >= 18 and has_ticket) or vip
